1879064396.desc: Before combat, rapidly increase your Focus.\n\nFocus is required to use some bow skills and is lost if you move.

1879073740.name: Snaring Web
1879073740.desc:
A ranged attack that targets the victim's legs with sticky webs, rooting them in place.<rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times.</rgb>

1879104844.name: Fertile Slime
1879104844.desc: Living slime coats the target's wounds and restores health.

1879136204.name: Fracture
1879136204.desc: You are capable of drawing an enemy's attention to yourself with this attack. Fracture can also interrupt inducted skills.

1879146828.name: Ent's Strength (Tactical)
1879146828.desc: This fellowship skill does direct tactical damage to your target and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879213900.name: Sudden Death (Melee)
1879213900.desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879244876.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879244876.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline enhances the your overall skill and utility while on your war-steed trading spear for javelin and taking the battle to the far field.

1879255500.name: Mounted Strike
1879255500.desc: A simple passing attack that increases attacking strength when successful.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879282892.name: Mark Target
1879282892.desc: Indicate to your allies this is a priority target.

1879302604.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Lossoth)
1879302604.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879305548.name: Blinding Upshot
1879305548.desc: This attack does additional Light damage for each point of Focus consumed.

1879316044.name: Slash
1879316044.desc: Slash a single target and generate Wrath. Places a stacking bleed on the target.

1879335500.name: Sunny Summer Kite
1879335500.desc: Brings out a sunny summer kite for you to fly in the wind.

1879360844.name: Yellow Snake
1879360844.desc: Brings out a yellow snake to keep you company.

1879368652.name: Black Peacock
1879368652.desc: Brings out a black peacock to keep you company.

1879374540.name: Guide to Járnfast
1879374540.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Járnfast.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879396940.name: Brown Marble Wolf-dog
1879396940.desc: Brings out a friendly wolf-dog to keep you company.

1879401420.name: Smoky-grey Cat
1879401420.desc: Brings out a smoky-grey cat to keep you company.

1879406156.name: Steed of Regal Revelry
1879406156.desc: A steed with noble bearing, tempered by many years of service.

1879411788.name: Weather Blows
1879411788.desc: Enter a temporary state wherein you are nearly unassailable. Nearly.\n\nThis effect will not stack with other incoming damage reduction effects.

1879447372.name: Russet Corgi
1879447372.desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.

1879461708.name: Guide to Clegur
1879461708.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Clegur in Swanfleet.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879466188.name: Righteous Fury
1879466188.desc: You revel in the fury and the fray, channeling your martial skill and prowess into deadly attacks and unlocking your response skills.

1879486028.name: Friend of the Wilds (Juvenile Swamp-guardian)
1879486028.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879492172.name: Cleave
1879492172.desc: Swing your weapon in an arc before you.

1879525324.name: Foe-shot Fireworks
1879525324.desc: Set off sinister bow shot fireworks!

1879528268.name: Prepared: Wisp of Frost
1879528268.desc: Gelid Wind adherents deal frost damage swiftly.

1879528780.name: Prepared: Acid-spike
1879528780.desc: Send a spike of acid at your target, weakening them.

1879529164.name: Test Self Radial
1879529164.desc: This is a radial AoE skill centered on the caster with limited targets.
